verdict.rationale: Render's own marketing states exactly this capability: it prevents non-production environments from accessing production services. The evidence is a single one-line homepage claim, so how the isolation works and how far it extends are unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of the isolation mechanism (e.g., environment-scoped network boundaries or rules), configuration steps, scope and limitations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
